text: In rural Lapland and across Finland, early cancer survival still depends too often on postal
code and age. Silta, with driver care, builds a bridge from inclusive voice and chat intake
to clinician review to county level intelligence. Layer 1 meets people where they are,
a warm phone checkup that listens before it asks. Layer 2 places a structured,
human-reviewable brief into an apodilite clinical workspace, proposals, not autonomous decisions.
Layer 3 illuminates 23 well-being services counties with a random forest model and
shop contributors, associations that guide strategy, not personal cancer probability.
Evidence from THL and the Finnish Cancer Registry. Aligned to national cancer strategy
2026-2035-goal3. Equal care across Finland. Silta Times Driver Care.
